topic: 非谓语动词 (Non-finite Verbs: Infinitives, Gerunds & Participles)
teaching_notes:
1. 【核心概念】：句子的“独生子女法则”——在英语的一个简单句中，只能有一个真正的谓语动词（主角）。如果还想使用其他动作，就必须让它们穿上“变身衣”，变为非谓语动词（to do, doing, done），充当名词、形容词或副词。
2. 【语法公式与口诀】：
- 目的将来用 to do（打算/目的：want to do, decide to do）
- 兴趣习惯用 doing（动名词/正在：enjoy doing, spend time doing）
- 主动进行用 doing，被动完成用 done（分词做修饰/状语）
3. 【中小学生易错点】：
- 易错1：一句话出现双谓语（如：*I like play football.* ❌ 应为 I like playing/to play football.）
- 易错2：介词后面忘记加 -ing（如：*He is good at swim.* ❌ 介词后必接动名词 swimming！）
- 易错3：中学分词状语的主语不一致/主被动混淆（如：*Looking out of the window, the tree was green.* ❌ 树不能“看”，应为 *Seen from the window...*）。
4. 【经典例句】：
- P4-P6: She decided to study hard for the English test.（她决定努力学习备考英语。）
- P4-P6: My younger brother enjoys playing basketball after school.（我弟弟喜欢放学后打篮球。）
- Form 1-5: Tired after a long day of work, Tom went to bed early.（工作了一天感到疲倦，汤姆早早睡觉了。）

questions.question: My sister decided _______ her bedroom this weekend.
questions.explanation: 动词 decide 后接不定式作宾语，固定搭配为 decide to do sth.（决定做某事）。

questions.question: Do you enjoy _______ storybooks in your free time?
questions.explanation: 动词 enjoy 后接动名词作宾语，固定搭配为 enjoy doing sth.（喜欢/享受做某事）。

questions.question: The students finished _______ their homework before 7:00 PM.
questions.explanation: 动词 finish 表示“完成”，后面必须接动名词形式 finish doing sth.。

questions.question: Our English teacher asked us _______ English every morning.
questions.explanation: 考查 ask sb. to do sth. 结构，意为“要求/叫某人做某事”，不定式作宾语补足语。

questions.question: Thank you for _______ me with my science project.
questions.explanation: for 是介词，介词后面接动词时，必须使用动名词形式（V-ing）。

questions.question: Peter is very good at _______ badminton.
questions.explanation: be good at 意为“擅长”，at 为介词，后接动名词 playing。

questions.question: My mother told me _______ too late on school nights.
questions.explanation: tell sb. not to do sth. 意为“告诉某人不要做某事”，不定式的否定形式是在 to 前面加 not。

questions.question: We are planning _______ a picnic near the lake next Sunday.
questions.explanation: plan to do sth. 意为“计划做某事”，用不定式表示将要发生的动作。

questions.question: What about _______ a chocolate cake for your birthday?
questions.explanation: What about / How about 用于提出建议，about 是介词，后接动名词 making。

questions.question: Lily spent two hours _______ her new model plane yesterday.
questions.explanation: spend time (in) doing sth. 意为“花费时间做某事”，后接动名词形式。

questions.question: Don't forget _______ your umbrella; it looks like rain.
questions.explanation: forget to do sth. 表示“记得要做某事（未做）”；forget doing sth. 表示“忘记做过某事（已做）”。根据句意，带伞是未发生的动作，用 to bring。

questions.question: The little boy wants _______ an astronaut when he grows up.
questions.explanation: want to be / do sth. 意为“想要成为/做某事”。

questions.question: The runner stopped _______ some water because he was very thirsty.
questions.explanation: stop to do sth. 意为“停下来去干另一件事”；stop doing sth. 意为“停止正在干的事”。运动员停下来是为了喝水，用 to drink。

questions.question: It is important for us _______ fresh water in our daily life.
questions.explanation: 句型：It is + adj. + for sb. + to do sth.，其中 It 为形式主语，动词不定式 to save 作真正主语。

questions.question: Look! The children are busy _______ for the Christmas party.
questions.explanation: be busy doing sth. 意为“忙于做某事”，后接动名词形式。

questions.question: _______ the bad news, she burst into tears and could not say a word.
questions.explanation: 现在分词 Hearing 作时间/原因状语，表示“一听到……”，动作与主语 she 是主动关系，且与主句动作几乎同时发生。

questions.question: You had better have your broken smartphone _______ before traveling.
questions.explanation: have sth. done 结构表示“使某事被做 / 让别人做某事”，smartphone 与 repair 是被动关系，用过去分词 repaired 作宾补。

questions.question: _______ the competition, the young athlete trained five hours every day.
questions.explanation: 动词不定式短语放在句首作目的状语（To win = In order to win），意为“为了赢得比赛”。

questions.question: The suspect was seen _______ into the building at around midnight.
questions.explanation: 感官动词 see sb. do sth. 改为被动语态时，省略的 to 必须还原，变为 sb. be seen to do sth.。

questions.question: _______ all his tasks ahead of time, David felt relaxed and went for a coffee.
questions.explanation: 现在分词的完成式 Having finished 作状语，强调“完成任务”这一动作发生在主句谓语动词 felt relaxed 之前。

questions.question: All the members are looking forward to _______ the new museum next month.
questions.explanation: look forward to 中的 to 是介词而非不定式符号，后面必须接动名词 visiting。

questions.question: The man _______ next to the principal is our new mathematics professor.
questions.explanation: 现在分词 standing 短语作后置定语修饰 The man，相当于定语从句 who is standing...

questions.question: Most of the classic novels _______ by Jin Yong are extraordinarily popular.
questions.explanation: 过去分词 written 作后置定语修饰 novels，表被动与完成，相当于 which were written by...

questions.question: He has devoted his whole life to _______ healthcare conditions in rural areas.
questions.explanation: devote... to... 结构中，to 为介词，后接动名词 improving 作宾语。

questions.question: _______ from the peak of the mountain, the entire city looks magnificent.
questions.explanation: 分词作状语时逻辑主语是 the entire city。城市是被观看（Seen from...），故用过去分词表示被动含义。

questions.question: With all the necessary preparations _______, the conference officially began.
questions.explanation: With 复合结构：With + 名词(preparations) + 过去分词(completed)。preparations 与 complete 为被动关系。

questions.question: The task is _______ complicated for a beginner to accomplish in one day.
questions.explanation: too... to... 结构表示“太……以至于不能做某事”。

questions.question: The concert seems _______ before we even stepped into the stadium.
questions.explanation: seem 后接不定式。由 before we stepped 可知“开始”这一动作发生在主句谓语之前，故使用不定式的完成式 to have started。

questions.question: _______ regular physical exercise into your daily routine reduces stress effectively.
questions.explanation: 动名词短语 Incorporating... 作句子的主语，谓语动词为单数形式 reduces。

questions.question: _______ of the potential cybersecurity risks, the company updated its system.
questions.explanation: 考查分词状语的完成被动式。主语 the company 与 warn 是被动关系（被警告），且“被警告”发生在“更新系统”之前，故用 Having been warned。
